name: HR & Attendance
nameTh: บุคคลและลงเวลา
description: Employee register (departments, positions, probation/resignation, link to a login), work calendar (holidays, start time, grace minutes, Saturday work), leave types with yearly quotas, leave requests (LV-…) with working-day calculation, balance check and approval by the employee's manager (org chart: direct manager or department head, HR override), and mobile check-in/check-out with GPS, late minutes, a daily board and a monthly attendance summary. No national ID numbers are stored.
